During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''weapons depot''' was established in the [[Lowlands (Lan Barell)|Lowlands]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] by members of the local [[Rebel cell (Lan Barell)|Rebel cell]] despite an agreement with the local [[Human-Qieg Guild|government]] that forbade stockpiling of heavy weapons. Comprised of several portable buildings, the depot was abandoned when a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] at the site was destroyed by members of the radical [[Qiemal]].
